content:
Dating reality shows have always been a hugely popular genre, but Apple TV has never ventured into it. While its newly announced series The Last Person on Earth is positioned as a "documentary series" rather than a "reality show," it is still the streamer's first dating show.

The Last Person on Earth will be hosted by renowned couples therapist Esther Perel and has been described as an "innovative experiment"

Perel is a well-known couples therapist and New York Times bestselling author who specializes in relationships.

Perel is also the subject of a newly announced 8-episode dating documentary series on Apple TV titled The Last Person on Earth.

According to the press release: "On the show, seemingly mismatched couples will be expertly paired by Perel and a team of matchmakers and therapists, then sent on a journey to one of the most romantic and remote destinations on the planet."

It sure sounds like a reality show, just without the baggage that comes with the "reality" branding. I'd wager Apple is going for a more "prestige" vibe with its dating show, hence the "documentary series" label.

Here's Perel introducing the show herself:

A premiere date for the series has yet to be announced, but it is expected to debut sometime in 2027.

Also announced by Apple yesterday: the streamer is adapting a brand-new romance novel from bestselling author Rebecca Yarros into a TV series. Clearly, the streamer is looking to branch out beyond its core sci-fi, comedy, and thriller offerings.

Apple TV costs $12.99 per month, or can be bundled for a discount via Apple One.
